The Full Moon in Scorpio on April 23rd, 2024, illuminates the depths of our inner world, revealing the mysteries that lie within. As the Moon "dances" with the Sun, it awakens our primal instincts, stirring the passions and desires that have been dormant. "The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall" - Nelson Mandela - as we confront our shadow selves and the secrets we've been keeping.

This Full Moon "unleashes" the intensity of Scorpio, a sign of rebirth and transformation. It's a call to confront the darkness within, to "face your fears and dance with the devil" - as the saying goes. Will you rise to the challenge, or will you succumb to the shadows? The choice is yours, under the watchful eye of the Scorpio Full Moon.
